rationale.conceptual: Standard application of an established interatomic potential formalism (2NN MEAM) using published parameters. No new algorithm or derivation; only careful formatting of LAMMPS input files and basic solid-state physics calculations.
rationale.execution: The pipeline requires preparing MEAM parameter files, creating simulation cells for 5 different crystal structures plus pure elements, running multiple energy minimizations (including 6+ strain states for elastic constants of Al12W), and post-processing results. This is a multi-stage orchestration with careful handling of units and coordinate systems, though each step is well-defined.
